description: List the keys or indexes at FILE#/POINTER, one per line; long adds type and size, depth lists deeper. Also reads markdown (read only): FILE.md#/Heading is a section, #/Heading/_ its own text, #/Heading/0 a list item or table row, a list item key: value by its key, a section holding only a json block as JSON. More: aos/tools/json_ls.md.
